column1: # Seven marks only: atac h3k4me3 h3k27ac h3k27me3 h3k9me3 h3k36me3 h3k4me1
# H3K9ac and DNase are not model inputs.
# Notes must start with '#' or they are parsed as picks.
# ROUTE B: accessibility comes from snATAC BAMs, converted locally with one
# fixed command, so MCF-10A can stay as the breast context. Use mark 'atac_bam'
# for those; 'atac' still means a ready-made fold-change bigWig.
# Prostate was dropped: ENCODE has no snATAC for it, only bulk ATAC, and mixing
# assays for one tissue reintroduces the confound this route exists to remove.
# then, once every line passes and the set is consistent across tissues:
# h3k9ac    ENCFF110TAI    not a model input
# ENCFF113XMQ was the original H3K4me3 pick, rejected as hg19
# The joint model's breast context. Same MCF-10A accessions the checksum audit
# recovered for the published model, but the ATAC is RE-CONVERTED from the BAM
# with this route's command -- the published data/reference/ATAC_seq.bw used
# unrecorded parameters and so cannot be matched by anything else.
# The breast-epithelium context, for the single-tissue ablation that decides
# whether MCF-10A is replaced everywhere. Primary tissue, bulk ATAC, all
# fold-change bigWigs -- nothing to convert. Lands in
# data/reference/BreastEpithelium/ and touches neither the published tracks nor
atac      ENCFF665NGK   # ENCFF720WSA was a Histone ChIP file, rejected
# REUSED, not converted. The published track's duplicate/MAPQ/extension settings
# are not recoverable from the bigWig, so a re-conversion could not reproduce it.
# Copying it in is the only way both models read the SAME breast ATAC file.
